sentences.text:
The petitioners being the owners of the land bearing Municipal No.75/69, BBMP PID No.55-445-75/69, New PID No.161-MOO21-21-75, Ward No.55, situated at 100 feet road, 5th Block,
Phase III, BSK Stage III, Bengaluru - 560 085 had approached respondent No.3 for grant of plan sanction to develop their property.

3. Respondent No.3 had issued an endorsement on 21.03.2022 of Annexure-H calling upon the petitioners to relinquish certain portion of the land which had been ear-marked for the purpose of widening of the road in the Revised Master Plan of 2015.
It is aggrieved by the same, the petitioners are before this Court seeking for aforesaid reliefs.

4. When the above petition was pending, a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 20.04.2022 had directed the respondents to consider the application of the petitioner without insisting upon the relinquishment deed as regards the area apart from NC: 2023:KHC:28669 area sought for relinquishment.

In pursuance thereof, the respondent has sanctioned the plan and as such, now it is contended by the respondent that the petition has spent itself and could be disposed in view of the plan sanctioned.

5. Though such a submission on the face of it appears to be a reasonable submission, however, the plan having been sanctioned in pursuance of a direction of this Court, the endorsement would continue to be in force so also the demand of respondent No.3.

6. This Court has in W.P.No.9408/2020 and other connected matters vide order dated 17.01.2022 categorically held that neither respondent No.2 nor respondent No.3 can seek for relinquishment of any land free of cost for the purpose of plan sanction and in terms of Section 69 of Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961, the same would have to be acquired in terms of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, NC: 2023:KHC:28669 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by making payment of necessary compensation.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Thus, merely because a plan has been sanctioned, the above petition would not be rendered infructuous.
The endorsement being unauthorized and without jurisdiction would be required to be quashed.

Hence, I pass the following:
ORDER i. The Writ Petition is allowed.
ii.
The endorsement bearing No.Ad.Com/SUT/ 1197/21-22 PRJ No.9017/21-22 dated 21.03.2022 at Annexure-H issued by respondent No.3 is quashed.

Sd/-
